rca_of_the_issue: Bug: Admin 'Grant Access' users kept role='user' but got subscription.tier='premium' — every frontend check (UploadPage.isPaidTier, ReportPage.premiumRole, dashboard variants) only inspected user.role, so these users saw the free-tier blurred HeroTeaser after analysis. Fix layers verified: (1) backend UserPublic + login + /auth/me + reset-password now return subscription_tier so the frontend has the data (verified via pytest); (2) new /app/frontend/src/lib/premium.js isPremiumUser() consumes role OR subscription_tier — single source of truth (source-audited); (3) UploadPage.handleSubmit's skipHeroTeaser branch also honors eligibility.reason==='subscription' AND finalData.is_paid — belt-and-suspenders. Reproduction confirmed non-triggerable now because the backend contract + frontend helper both evaluate correctly for the target user (role=user, subscription_tier=premium ⇒ isPaidTier=true ⇒ setPremiumReadyReport, never setHeroReport).
